Country and location: India, Manipur, 17 km east northeast of Imphal
Notes: Two people were seriously injured after a building collapsed in Imphal East District.

Country and location: Poland, Silesia, 4 km southeast of Paniówki
Notes: This small earthquake caused a mine collapse. One miner died and nine others were injured.

Country and location: Pakistan, Azad Kashmir, 4 km southwest of Jhelum
Notes: A house collapsed in Mirpur, killing one person and injuring some others. It was an aftershock of the 2019 Kashmir earthquake.

Country and location: Indonesia, Maluku, 12 km north northeast of Ambon
Notes: It was an aftershock of the 2019 Ambon earthquake. Serious damage was caused to a college, one pupil was killed by the rubble, and three others injured.

Country and location: Philippines, Soccsksargen, 7 km east northeast of Columbio
Notes: During the first of the 2019 Cotabato earthquakes, some infrastructure in Soccsksargen and Davao Region suffered damage, including a fire that occurred in General Santos. Around 200 people sustained injuries and 7 others died.

Country and location: Fiji, Kadavu offshore, 94 km south southwest of Suva
Notes: On Kadavu Island, minor damage and landslides occurred. Cracks in the ground were also observed.

Ascension Island offshore, North Atlantic Ocean
Spain, Andalusia, 2 km east northeast of Olvera
Notes: Schools were closed, and cracks on walls appeared on various buildings in Olvera.

Country and location: China, Gansu, 75 km southwest of Linxia City
Notes: 21 people were injured after the quake. 2,097 houses were damaged to varying degrees in the county.

Country and location: Philippines, Soccsksargen, 10 km northeast of Columbio
Notes: During the second of the 2019 Cotabato earthquakes, serious damage was caused in Davao and Soccksargen, where some buildings collapsed and many others were damaged. 14 people died, three were missing, and over 500 others were injured.

Country and location: Philippines, Soccsksargen, 2 km east northeast of Bulatukan
Notes: During the third of the 2019 Cotabato earthquakes, some buildings in Davao and Soccksargen were seriously damaged and an hotel completely collapsed. 10 more people died and one person was reported missing following a landslide.
